entries.notes: 四栏仅存零字（L.／ante.／U.），H 栏为空，无法确定词头与义项。
四栏错位残片（Q.／ante.／V.），R 栏为空，材料不足以定夺。

entries.zh: 方形的；四方形（四角，如谓世界为方形）
entries.en: square, four-square; square-shaped (as the world is said to be square)
entries.notes: M 栏 ca 旁标[疑:q/g]且多处 T99 污损；方／四角之义由 L 与 H 两栏互证。

entries.zh: 髋骨；胯骨（尻川骨）；亦指腰骨
entries.en: hip, hip-bone, haunch; also the waist bone (lumbar region)
entries.notes: M 栏多字 T99 污损，脚川骨（当读尻川骨）字形存疑；H 栏并出髋、腰两义。

entries.zh: 军阵的前队；头阵（第一队）
entries.en: the first squadron of an army; the van, front rank

entries.zh: 画像牌；装框的图像（圣像画牌）
entries.en: picture panel; a framed image or painting (religious image)
to curdle, to coagulate, to clot (as blood); to set into a lump
entries.notes: H 栏「澀」与 M 栏 guin（凝）音义不合，疑为「凝」之误录；义从 L cuajarse 定。
